adjudication.rationale: The diff removes the `method_option :category` and all logic that derived `category_id` and passed it into `PostCreator` in `lib/tasks/disqus.thor`. The import path is replaced with `TopicEmbed.import_remote(user, t[:link], title: t[:title])`, and neither `TopicEmbed.import_remote` nor `TopicEmbed.import` accepts/sets a category when creating the topic/post (`PostCreator.new(... title:, raw:, ... cook_method:)` has no category). Therefore the Thor task can no longer route imported threads to a specified category, which is a verifiable functional regression for prior users of `--category`/`-c`.
